verdict.rationale: A tax agency's online services could plausibly offer background automations such as scheduled or recurring filings and payments, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only interactive e-services: registration, filing, payments, email notifications and document submission. EFILE (cra-docs-14, cra-supp-3) is a channel for certified third-party software to transmit returns, not a CRA feature for configuring autonomous automations. That kind of building block and the adjacent email notifications earn no credit, so no first-party automation capability is documented.
